cases.name: hook-failure
cases.behavior: hook rejected commit; HEAD and unrelated work preserved

cases.name: hook-scope-expansion
cases.behavior: finding: pre-commit hook can expand commit scope despite --only
cases.required_boundary: Verify actual commit tree; preserve facts and report needs_attention, never assume --only is a sandbox or auto rewrite history.

cases.name: commit-success-receipt-lost
cases.behavior: actual subprocess exit after successful commit, no receipt; recovered by Git facts

cases.name: archive-move-checkpoint-lost
cases.behavior: move already applied; verified target then archive commit, no second move
